Privacy

Last updated: 5 November 2026

Who we are

Robbie P operates bitcoinslang.com. This policy explains what we collect when you visit or buy.

What we collect

  • Checkout: name/email (and whatever Stripe needs to take payment). Card data is handled by Stripe, not stored by us as full card numbers.
  • Orders: what you bought, when, and delivery status so we can send downloads and handle support.
  • Site use: basic hosting logs kept by our host (IP, browser, pages); we do not run analytics. These are used to keep the site working and secure.
  • Messages: anything you send us by email or social.

Why we use it

To provide the site, take payment, deliver downloads, prevent fraud/abuse, and reply to you. We do not sell your personal information.

Who else sees it

Stripe (payments). Email delivery providers if we use one to send download links. Hosting providers for the site and files (for example GitHub Pages / Cloudflare). They only get what they need to do that job.

Cookies

bitcoinslang.com does not use analytics, advertising, or marketing pixels.

Any cookies set are essential for running the site (for example, basic hosting) or are set by Stripe on Stripe’s own checkout domain when you pay. We don’t put tracking cookies on bitcoinslang.com for ads or analytics.

If that ever changes, we will update this policy.

How long we keep it

Order and email records as long as needed for the download, support, tax/accounting, and legal duties, then we delete or de-identify when we no longer need them.

Your choices

You can ask what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it where the law allows. Email us at music@robbiep.net (or message @robbiep808x on X). You can also use Stripe’s tools for payment-method details they store.

Kids

This shop is aimed at adults. Do not buy if you are under 18 without a parent or guardian.

Overseas

Some providers (Stripe, hosting) may process data outside Australia. We use them so the site and payments work.

Changes

We may update this policy; the “Last updated” date will change. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated policy.
